reasoning: This is an AI-powered customer support triage system for FairTix, a ticket marketplace. The workflow monitors Gmail every minute for emails with 'Support Request' in the subject line, uses Anthropic's Claude to classify each message into categories (FAQ, Account/Verification, Payment/Billing, etc.) and sentiment levels, then logs the structured data to Google Sheets. The detailed prompt reveals FairTix's business model: fair queue system, price transparency, resale caps, verification processes. This is critical infrastructure for scaling customer support - without it, human agents would manually read and categorize every incoming support request. name: FairTix Support Message Auto-Classification
businessNarrative: This workflow automates the initial triage of customer support requests for FairTix's ticket marketplace, using AI to categorize messages by issue type and emotional urgency. It enables the support team to prioritize responses - angry customers with payment issues get immediate attention while neutral FAQ requests can be handled by junior staff or automated responses. The sophisticated classification logic reveals FairTix's complex business model with fair queues, price caps, and verification requirements. This automation is essential for scaling customer support without proportionally increasing headcount, directly impacting customer satisfaction metrics and operational efficiency.
